No single fixed C dominates every K in measured DMR. C4 has the lowest exploratory equal-K mean, but C2 is lower at K6 in every round. Adequacy to an unspecified deployment/SLA is not established.

Opposite repeat-consistent static preferences and distinct queue/service/blocked-state regimes motivate testing adaptation. Static data do not measure achievable online improvement or transition cost.
